title: Tom DeLonge contacts Levenda to investigate UFOs
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Tom DeLonge contacts Levenda to investigate UFOs, about 2014-2015 at unspecified (phone and email), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Tom contacted me I think much the way you you No. Um, just out of the clear blue sky. >> And it was the end of 2014.

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda told the podcast host Jesse Michels that a man named Tom DeLonge got in touch with him out of the blue at the end of 2014, by phone and email, to look into UFOs. Levenda tells it as the start of his own involvement in a private effort to investigate the subject.
